name: (05) Thaumaturgy (Movement of the Mind) — 3 Advanced — Control

system.description:
The master grips a target in mental force and bends its every motion to their will, spinning cars through the air or tying a shoelace with equal precision.

You can heft anything up to a ton and manipulate it with the precision of both hands; such objects strike for one level of lethal damage, and a weapon controlled remotely deals its normal damage but forces you to bid an extra Trait. Make a Mental Challenge against a seized victim's Physical Traits to grab them, and again on any turn you move them; you need no further test merely to hold them immobile. Slamming a victim into a hard surface inflicts one lethal level. Control affects only physical motion, so the subject can still speak and use Disciplines. It requires all your concentration and ends if you lose sight of the target. Retest with Occult.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
